questions.question: What is the antonym of 'Slender'?
questions.rationale: 'Slender' (दुबला-पतला) is the opposite of Stout, Chubby, or Fatty (मोटा, भारी).

questions.question: What is the antonym of 'Omnipotent'?
questions.rationale: 'Omnipotent' (सर्वशक्तिशाली) is the opposite of Powerless, Fragile, Feeble, or Weak (कमजोर).

questions.question: Which word means the opposite of 'Pacify / Assuage'?
questions.rationale: 'Pacify / Assuage' (शांत करना) is opposite in meaning to Inflame, Infuriate, or Provoke (भड़काना)।

questions.question: 'Veteran' is the opposite of:
questions.rationale: 'Veteran' (अनुभवी) is the opposite of Amateur, Fresher, or Tyro (नौसिखिया)।
